prompt: A teammate just opened a PR that adds a login endpoint to our NestJS app: it checks the user's password and mints a JWT for the browser client. It technically works — users can log in — but I want you to review this as if you were the approver on the PR. Walk me through everything you'd flag in the sign call and the token's payload/lifetime, why each issue actually matters, and how you'd fix it without breaking the stateless auth model the rest of the app relies on.
